D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P AVG ; R/ PA[X] AVG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), possibly London mint, cf. RIC vol. 5 part 2 pages 535-536 and Moorhead (nd) p. 153 fig. 33. Obverse description: Radiate bullnecked bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS P AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left with vertical spear holding flower in right hand. Reverse inscription: PA[X] AVG. Diameter: 22.2mm,…
